scoring.projection: A representation's projection of a world is the typed fields it holds that bear on the pair's query. Descriptive prose (commit bodies, README narrative, free-text JSON fields such as 'override', 'basis', 'reason', 'prompt') never counts. Natural-language text counts only where it is the designated authority record for a grant or a prohibition: the owner's current instruction to a session, a dated owner or delegated decision record, CLAUDE.md's dated boundaries.

decision_rules.A: the repaired contract's rules applied to current repository records, without falsifier_assessment
decision_rules.B: the repaired contract's rules applied to current repository records plus falsifier_assessment (the local kernel change)
decision_rules.C: Gemini's 8-tuple under its own Delta: admit iff Ac >= ReqAuthority and Vc != FAIL and Fe = CURRENT; cold entry sets Ac to empty; fields read charitably as Gemini defines them
decision_rules.K: the repaired contract with every listed field and rule, used only for component ablation

regimes.RECORDED: fields as the records are populated today
regimes.CAPACITY: fields as an existing convention of the same representation would populate them for this case; a convention counts only if the repository already populates it for some real case, with a citation

scoring.distinguishes: for a primary pair: the rule yields D0 on W0 and D1 on W1. A control passes when the rule yields the same, correct decision on both worlds. UNDECIDED is never correct.
scoring.insufficient: B is insufficient if it fails any primary pair in CAPACITY (a representation gap: name the missing distinction). Failing only in RECORDED is a usage gap: name the population rule.
scoring.unearned: a component is unearned if masking it leaves every primary pair distinguished and every control passed in CAPACITY. Single-removal results are reported for every component. Backward elimination then removes components in the listed order, keeping a removal only if nothing collapses; the survivors are an irreducible set. Where two components are each sufficient alone, both are reported as a redundancy group.
scoring.stop: STOP if B distinguishes every primary pair in CAPACITY. E2 (behavioural) is proposed only if a primary pair stays undistinguished in CAPACITY and no existing record type can carry the distinction.
scoring.masking: a masked grant field matches anything; a masked verification field matches anything; a masked record type is absent (grants absent = ambient authority; verifications absent = requirements ignored; receipts absent = attribution UNDECIDED; transitions or assessments absent = relation UNASSESSED); a masked rule reverts to its weakest reading (fail_closed -> only FAIL blocks; derive_now -> stored results reused; req_per_check -> one aggregate result; recheck_at_execution -> admission-time subject; default_deny -> no grant means allowed; veto -> ignored; epi_evidence -> corrections need no evidence)
